manage.name: Room name
manage.clear_body: The messages stay, but the agents forget them: each starts a fresh conversation, and the summary and token count start over.
manage.leave_body: You leave “{name}”. To come back you need its code again.
manage.seat_add_title: Add an agent to the room
manage.seat_intro: Each agent in a room has its own name, role, instructions and model.
manage.seat_name_hint: People mention it as @name; unique in the room.
manage.seat_name_add_hint: Empty for the agent's own name. People mention it as @name; unique in the room.
manage.seat_instructions_hint: Given to this agent on every turn in this room.
manage.seat_model_hint: Leave empty for the agent's own model.
manage.seat_remove_body: It leaves the room; what it said stays.
manage.settings_handoff: Agents may pass the turn to each other
manage.settings_handoff_hint: An agent may hand the next reply to another agent of the room.
manage.settings_max_depth_hint: 1 to 20; empty for no limit. A pass repeated in the same run always stops.
manage.handoff_stopped_max_depth: Stopped passing the turn: @{from} → @{to} would go past the room's limit.
manage.handoff_stopped_loop_detected: Stopped passing the turn: @{from} → @{to} would repeat a pass already made.
manage.handoff_stopped_interrupted: Passing the turn was stopped at @{from} → @{to}.
manage.handoff_stopped_error: Passing the turn stopped: @{to} could not answer.
manage.memory_none: No summary yet. It is written every few messages, and agents are told it on every turn.
